title: Split giant BFF router closures by cohesive use case
summary: Decomposed the monolithic 3420-line Persona Management router into 5 cohesive resource/use-case subrouters (collection, detail, lifecycle, provisioning, ranking) sharing a strongly-typed PersonaRouteContext. Eliminated module-level globals() mutations in PersonaService.__init__, dynamic namespace forwarding loops, and wildcard imports. Bound read_surface_meta and dataset_surface_status to instance methods and request-scoped ContextVar to eliminate cross-instance metadata contamination. Added two-instance real-router data and metadata isolation regression test.

parent_factory.description: Thin parent factory creating PersonaRouteContext, building 5 subrouters, and extending router.routes. No closures over module globals; no wildcard imports.

subrouters.scope: Persona collection, fleet catalog, intent listing, and creation
Persona instance details, patching, runtime profile, capabilities, skills, tools, activity, memory, audit
Persona lifecycle transitions, sessions, strategy discovery, actions, and paper eligibility proof
Persona league, quarterly ranking, recommendations, movers, heatmap, and promotion reviews

context_model.description: Dataclass holding explicitly injected typed ports and helpers. make_context_dependency attaches async generator dependency setting _current_persona_service ContextVar per request.

metadata_isolation_fix.root_cause: PersonaService.__init__ previously mutated module globals (globals()["read_store"], globals()["command_store"], _ranking_write_owner). Helper functions _read_surface_meta and _dataset_surface_status read module-level store globals, causing any newly created PersonaService instance to contaminate the response metadata of older instances.
metadata_isolation_fix.resolution: Removed all globals() mutations from PersonaService.__init__. Bound read_surface_meta and dataset_surface_status as instance methods on PersonaService. Introduced _current_persona_service ContextVar for request-scoped access in helper functions with active getters (_get_active_read_store, _get_active_command_store, _get_active_ranking_write_owner).

regression_test.verification: Instantiates Client 1 with seeded store and Client 2 with missing store. Confirms Client 1 returns status=ok, source=typed_store, Client 2 returns status=unavailable, source=missing, and subsequent queries to Client 1 remain clean and uncontaminated with status=ok, source=typed_store.
